Subject: Vendor security questionnaire: proposed path + evidence prioritization

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed path for the security kickoff so we can keep procurement moving:

Summary (call):
- Use case: HealthRow will route protected PII for summarization and triage (low-latency inference, batched embeddings).
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 attestation, HIPAA compatibility, EU residency option for future cohorts.

Recommended questionnaire path (we suggest order to minimize back-and-forth):
1) Start with SIG (full) only if you need an in-depth control mapping. Otherwise CAIQ + supplemental HIPAA section covers most procurement needs.
2) Parallel: provide our SOC 2 summary and SOC 2 Type II report (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf attached).
3) Evidence prioritization (what we should deliver first):
   - Encryption in transit and at rest: config snippets + KMS policy (high priority)
   - Dataflow diagram + third-party subprocessors (medium)
   - Retention & deletion playbook + sample logs (lower)

Can you confirm: 1) whether your legal/procurement prefers SIG or CAIQ as the checklist? 2) any strict timeline for SOC 2 evidence (e.g., procurement gate date)?

I attached a quick prefill template (healthrow_sig_prefill.xlsx) — if you prefer, we can prefill CAIQ answers and route them to your security inbox.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm desired questionnaire type and the procurement date.
- We prefill and return the CAIQ/SIG-lite within 3 business days.
- If HIPAA-specific artifacts are required, we loop in Marissa (security) for the evidence bundle.

Thanks —
Priyom
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
